description: MenuSelect renders a labeled listbox button for selecting one option from a list.

elements.name: label
elements.description: The accessible label associated with the menu select.

elements.name: options
elements.description: The available options. Each option requires a unique value and a displayed label.

elements.name: value / defaultValue
elements.description: Controls the selected option or sets the initial option. Use value with onValue for a controlled component, or defaultValue for an uncontrolled component.

elements.name: onValue
elements.description: Receives the selected MenuSelectOption when the user chooses an option.

elements.name: variant
elements.description: Sets the visual style to outlined (default) or underlined.

elements.name: size
elements.description: Sets the field size to sm, md (default), or lg.

elements.name: floatingLabel
elements.description: Places the label inside the field until it is opened or contains a selected value.

elements.name: labelPosition
elements.description: Places a non-floating label at the top (default) or left of the field.

elements.name: required
elements.description: Marks the field as required and displays the required indicator.

elements.name: error
elements.description: Displays validation feedback and associates the message with the select through aria-describedby.

elements.name: readOnly
elements.description: Prevents the user from opening the menu or changing the selected option.

elements.name: iconLeft / iconRight
elements.description: Adds an SVG component or icon configuration as a left or right adornment.

elements.name: width
elements.description: Sets the width of the field wrapper using a CSS length value.

elements.name: containerProps
elements.description: Passes native div properties to the field container.

elements.name: Native button properties
elements.description: Button properties such as disabled, name, form, and event handlers are forwarded to the trigger button.

accessibility.general: The component uses a button with aria-haspopup="listbox" and an associated ul listbox with option roles. It exposes the expanded state, active option, selected option, validation state, and accessible label to assistive technologies.
elements: Always provide a meaningful label; it is associated with the trigger button and listbox.
The trigger supports opening with Enter, Space, or the arrow keys. The listbox supports arrow navigation, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, typeahead, and selection with Enter or Space.
The selected option is exposed with aria-selected, and the current keyboard target is exposed with aria-activedescendant.
Error messages are announced politely with aria-live="polite" and linked to the trigger with aria-describedby.
Use readOnly when the value should remain visible but the user must not change it; use disabled when the control should be unavailable.
